_doc: Anti-patterns the humanize pass must strip. Em dashes are ZERO TOLERANCE per Mike's standing rule. LLM tells are common ChatGPT/Claude phrases that immediately give the AI away.

em_dashes.replacement_rule: Replace with period if at clause boundary; comma if mid-clause; colon if introducing a list. Choose by reading the sentence.

its_not_x_its_y.replacement_rule: Mike doesn't write this. Rewrite as a single declarative statement instead.
its_not_x_its_y.example_bad: It's not a tool, it's a system.
its_not_x_its_y.example_good: It's a system. Tool framing misses what it actually does.

delve.replacement_rule: Replace with 'dig into', 'look at', 'unpack', or just cut.

moreover.replacement_rule: Cut. Start a new paragraph or use 'And' or 'Also'.

in_today_fast_paced_world.replacement_rule: Cut entirely. This phrase is a tell.

navigate_the_landscape.replacement_rule: Replace with concrete verb (e.g., 'figure out', 'get through', 'survive', 'work in').

harness_the_power.replacement_rule: Replace with concrete verb (e.g., 'use', 'wire up', 'put to work').

in_conclusion.replacement_rule: Cut. Mike's closes are verdict statements, not summaries.

as_an_ai.replacement_rule: Cut entirely. This is a system tell.

leverage_as_verb.replacement_rule: Replace with 'use', 'wire up', 'put to work', 'lean on'.

robust.replacement_rule: Replace with concrete claim. 'Robust system' means nothing. 'Survives a 3am API outage' means something.

seamlessly.replacement_rule: Cut. If integration is truly seamless, prove it with detail. If not, don't claim it.

decorative_triplet.replacement_rule: Only flag if the three items are decorative/parallel (faster, better, stronger). Keep if they're concrete and load-bearing. Manual judgment.

rhetorical_question_close.replacement_rule: Mike's closes are verdict statements. Replace closing rhetorical question with a declarative line. Only at piece-end, not mid-piece.
